title: Flashcards: Friday and the two Eids
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Special days, summer and numbers
source: Written for arabic/y3 lesson 5 (Flashcards: Friday and the two Eids (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 5: Special days: Friday and the two Eids. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

cards:
عِيدُ الأَضْحَى
'id al-adha
at Hajj time

عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ
'id mubarak
a blessed Eid
blocks.task: say the Arabic, turn over and check, or play pairs with a partner.

keywords.def: Friday, the day of Jumu'ah prayer
the Eid of the sacrifice, at Hajj time

questions.q: What do we say to someone on Eid?
Which Eid is at Hajj time?
Core: Copy and match: يَوْمُ الجُمُعَةِ / عِيدُ الفِطْرِ / عِيدُ الأَضْحَى with Friday / Eid after Ramadan / Eid at Hajj time.
questions.a: يَوْمُ الجُمُعَةِ = Friday; عِيدُ الفِطْرِ = Eid after Ramadan; عِيدُ الأَضْحَى = Eid at Hajj time

questions.q: Extend: Make an Eid card (shapes and patterns, no people) and write عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ on it.
questions.a: Card with عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ written neatly

questions.q: Stretch: Write: اليَوْمُ يَوْمُ الجُمُعَةِ and say what it means.

questions.a: B) عِيدُ الفِطْرِ ('id al-fitr). 'Id al-fitr is the Eid of breaking the fast, after Ramadan. 'Id al-adha is at Hajj time.

questions.q: What is Friday in Arabic? A) يَوْمُ الجُمُعَةِ B) عِيدُ الفِطْرِ C) مَسْجِد
Big question: which days are special for Muslims, and what are they called in Arabic?
questions.a: Friday يَوْمُ الجُمُعَةِ, and the two Eids: عِيدُ الفِطْرِ and عِيدُ الأَضْحَى.
